registration: each admitted parent generation; startup/recovery is idempotent; no_watch opts out

end.also: confirmed close without a notice-owning terminal report in the same episode

blocker.rearm: new activity or accepted progress followed by a new error report
blocker.precedence: error is blocker, not also end

quiet=N.condition: no genuine activity advance for N positive minutes from registration/activity baseline

coalescence: one source fact satisfies matching subscriptions through one keyed notice identity
delivery: one transaction consumes triggers and inserts or finds a keyed notice; urgent delivery is opt-in
rollback: retire triggers and settle unsupported pending notices before rollback; do not replay overdue notices after re-enable
